auth_sign_in_description: Sign in to send and receive files, snippets, and links.
auth_sign_up_description: Sign up to send and receive files, snippets, and links.
auth_username_too_short: Username must be at least {min} characters
auth_username_too_long: Username must be at most {max} characters
auth_username_invalid_chars: Username may only contain letters, digits, _ and -, and must start with a letter or digit
auth_password_breached: This password has appeared in a data breach. Choose a different one.
auth_password_rule_mixed_case: An uppercase and a lowercase letter
auth_password_rule_symbol: A symbol (a space does not count)
auth_password_reset_invalid_link: The password reset link is invalid or missing
auth_password_reset_success: Password has been reset. Please sign in with your new password.
auth_forgot_password_description: Enter your email and we'll send you a link to reset it.
auth_reset_link_sent_description: If that address has an account, a password reset link is on its way.
auth_reset_request_throttled: Too many requests. Try again in {minutes} min.
auth_reset_request_unavailable: This instance can't send email right now.
upload_share_description: Upload a file, paste code, or shorten a link.
upload_shared_missing_description: Share it again from the other app.
install_app_ios_description: Safari installs web apps from its share menu. Once installed, it opens full screen from your home screen.
upload_settings_expiry_invalid: Enter a duration of at least 1 minute, in whole minutes
upload_settings_expiry_too_long: This site keeps shares for at most {max}
upload_result_open: Open share link in new tab
upload_result_delete_confirm_description: This removes the link and its content immediately. This can't be undone.
home_description: The default locale is set to Traditional Chinese.
home_subtitle: This app uses the shared monorepo i18n package.
share_retrieve_description: Enter the code you were given.
share_not_found_description: This code doesn't match any share. It may have been mistyped.
share_gone_description: It expired or has already been retrieved as many times as it allows.
share_rate_limited_description: Slow down and try again in a moment.
share_locked_description: Enter the password to view this share.
share_join_keep_open: Keep this tab open until the download finishes.
share_join_failed_description: The file could not be put together. Try downloading again.
share_no_preview: No preview available for this file
share_one_time_file: This is a one-time share. It stops working once downloaded, so there is no preview.
share_one_time_text: This is a one-time share. It stops working once viewed.
share_link_description: This share takes you to another website.
share_preview_too_large: Too large to preview — download it instead
user_page_description: Manage your profile, password, and active sessions
user_sessions_description: Where this account has been signed in. Sessions that have already ended are listed too, so you can tell whether anyone else has been in.
user_sessions_revoke_confirm_description: That device is signed out immediately and has to sign in again to use this account.
user_profile_description: Update your username and email address
user_profile_current_password_hint: Enter your current password to confirm it's you before changing your name or email.
user_profile_taken: That name or email is already in use
user_profile_email_unverified: Your new email address hasn't been verified yet.
user_email_verification_sent: Sent. Open the link in your inbox.
user_email_verification_throttled: Too many emails sent. Try again in {minutes} min.
user_email_verification_unavailable: Email can't be sent right now. Try again later.
user_verify_email_done_description: This address is now confirmed as yours.
user_verify_email_unusable: This link can't be used. It may have expired or already been used; send a new one from your account settings.
user_verify_email_missing: This link is incomplete. Open it again from the email.
user_api_keys_revoke_confirm_description: Anything using it stops working immediately. This can't be undone.
user_api_keys_create_description: Give it a name you'll recognize, and tick only what it needs.
user_api_keys_secret_warning: This is the only time the key is shown. If you lose it, revoke it and create a new one.
user_password_changed: Password updated. You've been signed out on every other device.
user_password_set_description: You signed up through another service, so this account has no password yet. Set one to also sign in with your username or email.
user_password_set_done: Password set. You've been signed out on every other device.
change_password_required_description: Set a new password for your account before continuing.
user_passkeys_description: Sign in with a fingerprint, face or security key — no password or code needed.
user_danger_description: Actions that affect every device, some of them permanent
user_danger_revoke_description: Revoke every active connection except this device. Useful if you forgot to sign out somewhere.
user_danger_delete_description: Permanently remove this account and sign out every device. This can't be undone.
user_danger_delete_confirm_description: A deleted account can't be restored, and you'll be signed out everywhere.
user_danger_delete_shares_on: Every link you've handed out stops working immediately.
user_danger_delete_shares_off: Links you've handed out keep working until they expire.
user_danger_delete_admin_notice: You're an administrator. If you're the last person who can administer this server, give that permission to another account before deleting.
user_danger_delete_last_admin: You're the last person who can administer this server. Give the permission to another account first.
user_reauth_required: For your security, sign in again to confirm it's you, then try once more.
user_prefs_time_format_description: How times are displayed for this account
user_prefs_theme_description: The theme is stored for the current user only.
user_prefs_app_theme_description: Pick the overall visual theme. It applies everywhere.
user_prefs_app_theme_graphite_descriptio: Cool-toned interface with tighter, lower-contrast layers.
user_prefs_app_theme_sepia_description: Warm paper tones, easier on long reading sessions.
user_prefs_app_theme_matsu_description: Warm paper with an olive cast, soft like hand-drawn animation.
user_prefs_app_theme_cosmic_description: Deep blue-violet, at its best in dark mode.
user_prefs_app_theme_slate_description: Clean cool grey that stays out of the way.
user_prefs_app_theme_vintage_description: Low-contrast tea-stained paper, like old print.
user_prefs_accent_description: Pick an accent color to personalize the interface
user_prefs_save_failed: Could not save your appearance preference.
shares_delete_dialog_description: The link becomes invalid immediately, even for someone who already has the retrieval code. Files are removed later by background cleanup — this can't be undone.
shares_bulk_delete_failed: {count} couldn't be deleted, please try again
shares_dead_note: Inactive shares are removed automatically after a few days, or you can delete them now.
all_shares_dead_note: Expired and used-up shares have their files cleared within an hour and stop using space. The record stays until the date shown next to its status, so old links say "expired". You can delete it now if you'd rather not wait.
oidc_error_generic: That sign-in did not go through. Please try again.
oidc_error_unavailable: That sign-in method is not set up on this site, or could not be reached. Try another way in.
oidc_error_stale: That sign-in took too long, or the link had already been used. Please start again.
oidc_error_refused: The provider refused the sign-in. Please try again, or use another way in.
oidc_error_no_address: The provider did not give us a verified email address, and an account needs one. Verify your address with them, then try again.
oidc_error_not_permitted: Your account is not in a group this site allows. Ask an administrator for access.
oidc_error_not_invited: This site is not open for sign-ups. You need an invitation to create an account here.
oidc_error_address_taken: An account here already uses that email address. Sign in with your password, then link the provider from your account page.
oidc_error_disabled: That account has been disabled. Please contact an administrator.
oidc_error_already_linked: That account is already linked to somebody else here.
oidc_error_sign_in_again: For your security, sign in again before linking a new sign-in method. Then press Link once more.
user_identities_description: Other accounts you can sign in to Tessera with.
user_identities_error: Could not load your sign-in methods.
user_identities_none_configured: This site has no third-party sign-in set up.
user_identities_last_way_in: This is the only way into your account. Add a password or another method before unlinking it.
auth_invite_description: This site is invite-only. Ask whoever runs it for a code.
auth_registration_closed_description: This site is not taking new accounts. If you already have one, sign in — including with a third-party account you have linked.
auth_register_pending_description: We sent a confirmation link to {email}. Open it to finish creating your account.
auth_register_confirm_missing_token_desc: Open this page from the link in your confirmation email.
auth_register_confirm_link_unusable_desc: The confirmation link is unknown, already used, or expired. Sign up again to get a new one.
auth_register_confirm_closed_description: This site stopped taking new accounts while this link was waiting to be used.
auth_register_confirm_taken_description: Someone else registered that username while this link was waiting. Sign up again with a different one.
auth_register_confirm_generic_descriptio: Something went wrong. Sign up again to get a new confirmation link.
all_shares_card_description_empty: Everyone's uploaded shares, including anonymous ones. Retrieval codes are not shown here.
all_shares_card_description_total: {total} total. Retrieval codes are not shown here.
all_shares_delete_dialog_description: The link becomes invalid immediately, even for someone who already has the retrieval code. Files are removed later by background cleanup — this can't be undone.
dashboard_config_description: The values in force right now. Most can be changed in Settings and apply immediately; those marked "Restart required" are fixed at startup.
dashboard_recent_shares_description: The newest shares, including anonymous ones
dashboard_storage_backend_unreachable: {name} is unreachable — shares stored on it can't be opened right now.
dashboard_storage_backends_note: Text shares live in the database itself, not on any backend.
dashboard_storage_description: Total content on this instance, and where it actually lives
dashboard_storage_location_of_total: {percent}% of all content · no capacity limit
dashboard_storage_no_quota_warning: Guest uploads are on and there is no total content limit — anyone who can reach this instance can fill the disk.
dashboard_trend_description_shares: Shares at the end of each day, and how many could still be opened
dashboard_trend_description_storage: Storage used at the end of each day
dashboard_trend_description_traffic: Total sent by shares still on the instance — it drops when a share is swept
dashboard_trend_empty_description: Daily figures are recorded from the day this version was deployed. The trend appears once there are at least two days.
dashboard_trend_gap_note: Gaps are days the server wasn't running, so nothing was recorded.
invites_card_description: Give a code to someone you want to let in; they enter it when signing up.
invites_create_description: One code can admit several people, so you can send it to a whole group.
invites_create_expires_description: Leave blank for a code that never expires.
invites_create_uses_description: Set to 1 for a single-use code.
invites_created_copy_failed: Couldn't access the clipboard. Select the link above and copy it manually.
invites_created_description: This code is shown only once. After you close this, not even an administrator can see it again. Send the sign-up link: opening it fills the code in for them.
invites_revoke_dialog_description: The code will be removed from the list and can no longer be used to sign up. Accounts already created with it are not affected.
roles_byte_limit_custom_description: A limit of its own, in the unit picked beside it.
roles_byte_limit_inherit_description: {inheritLabel} — follows whenever the site-wide setting changes
roles_byte_limit_unlimited_description: This role doesn't apply its own limit
roles_card_description: Permissions are a fixed list decided by the program; roles are what can be added or removed. Built-in roles can't be deleted or have their permissions changed.
roles_delete_dialog_description_empty: This role currently has no members.
roles_delete_dialog_description_with_mem: There are currently {members} accounts in this role. After deletion they'll be left without a role — able to sign in, but unable to do anything.
roles_editor_blocked_warning: This role has permissions you don't hold yourself (
roles_editor_description_custom: Permissions are submitted as a full set, not just the changed part.
roles_editor_description_system: Name and quotas can be changed; permissions are fixed.
settings_account_description: Who can sign up, what new accounts can do, and how long people stay signed in.
settings_account_form_default_role_descr: Newly registered accounts get this role.
settings_account_form_login_history_desc: Lets people check past sign-ins on their account page to spot anyone else. Defaults to 90 days.
settings_account_form_registration_descr: When closed, new people can't sign up or create an account through third-party sign-in. Admins can still create accounts by hand.
settings_account_form_roles_error: (Couldn't load roles; only the current value is available.)
settings_account_form_session_ttl_descri: How long until people have to sign in again. Defaults to 30 days.
settings_appearance_form_accent_descript: The color of buttons, links, and focus outlines.
settings_appearance_form_mode_descriptio: Visitors can still switch it themselves. Defaults to the device setting.
settings_appearance_form_theme_cosmic_de: A deep blue-violet night sky, best in dark mode.
settings_appearance_form_theme_descripti: Colors for backgrounds, text, and borders.
settings_appearance_form_theme_matsu_des: Warm rice paper with olive green, a soft hand-drawn tone.
settings_appearance_form_theme_sepia_des: Warm as paper, comfortable for long reading.
settings_appearance_form_theme_slate_des: A clean, cool gray that stays out of the content's way.
settings_appearance_form_theme_vintage_d: Low-contrast tea-stained paper, like old print.
settings_appearance_preview_card_descrip: Guests will see this color scheme until they choose one themselves.
settings_auth_providers_discord_descript: Fill in your Discord application's Client ID and Client Secret to turn it on.
settings_auth_providers_discord_scopes_h: Separated by spaces. Must include email, or sign-in fails because no email is returned.
settings_auth_providers_github_base_url_: Only needed for self-hosted GitHub Enterprise. Leave blank for github.com.
settings_auth_providers_github_descripti: Fill in your GitHub OAuth App's Client ID and Client Secret to turn it on.
settings_auth_providers_github_scopes_hi: Separated by spaces. Must include user:email, or sign-in fails because no email is returned.
settings_feature_form_accounts_descripti: Sign-up, sign-in, and accounts. When off there are no accounts at all — only anonymous uploads.
settings_feature_form_accounts_off_warni: With accounts off nobody can sign in, so you'll lose access to this panel on your next reload.
settings_feature_form_admin_description: What this panel itself runs on. Once off, it can only be restored with a command on the server.
settings_feature_form_admin_lockout_titl: Saving this locks you out of this panel
settings_feature_form_lockout_confirm_de: After saving you won't be able to open this panel or undo it here. To restore it, run the command below on the server and restart:
settings_feature_form_lockout_docker_hin: On Docker, prefix the command with docker exec <container>, then restart the container.
settings_og_description: The image shown when a share link is posted in a chat app.
settings_og_layout_description: Leave blank for the built-in card; once set, it applies to every share. Only div, span, and inline svg are allowed, styled with style or tw, and nothing can be loaded from elsewhere.
settings_og_builtin_note: No layout set: every share uses the built-in card. Start from a template to preview one here.
settings_og_preview_hint: Drawn with the same engine and fonts as the server, in all four states. Looking right on your own file doesn't mean it works on a locked share.
settings_og_sample_title_description: Try a long one, or one in Chinese or Korean: that is where layouts break. Not saved.
settings_og_locked_note: Locked shares only fill in title, label, footer, and code; every other placeholder is empty.
settings_og_engine_loading: Loading the renderer (about 7 MB, once per visit)…
settings_og_engine_failed: The renderer would not load, so there is no preview: {reason}
settings_features_description: Turn whole features off. Once off, their pages and API disappear.
settings_form_fields_sealed_description_: Already set. It isn't shown here for security; leave blank to keep it.
Takes effect when saved and won't be shown again.
settings_form_fields_sealed_placeholder_: Set — leave blank to keep it
settings_form_footer_read_only: You can view these settings but not change them.
settings_guest_warning_account_action: change the default role for new accounts
settings_guest_warning_body_before: New accounts get the guest role (no permissions), but uploads without an account are still on, so anyone can just sign out and upload. To actually block it, go to
settings_guest_warning_title: The guest role isn't stopping anyone
settings_guest_warning_upload_action: turn off "Allow uploads without an account"
settings_mail_description: Password resets and sign-up confirmations are sent through this.
settings_mail_form_from_description: The domain has to be verified with your SMTP service, or mail bounces.
settings_mail_form_host_description: Leave blank to turn email off.
settings_mail_form_host_empty_warning: Password resets and sign-up confirmations need email. Add an SMTP service such as Resend, Brevo, or Amazon SES — home connections usually can't send mail directly.
settings_mail_form_password_description: For most services this is an API key.
settings_mail_form_tls_description: "Automatic" is recommended: TLS on port 465, STARTTLS on other ports.
settings_mail_form_tls_none_warning_body: Only for a mail service on this machine or your local network. If the host isn't local, sending is refused.
settings_mail_form_public_url_descriptio: Links in emails start with this. Usually the same as the site's public URL.
settings_mail_form_registration_ttl_desc: Defaults to 24 hours, up to 7 days. Email verification links use this too.
settings_mail_form_reset_ttl_description: Defaults to 30 minutes, up to 24 hours. The link works like a temporary password, so keep it short.
settings_network_description: Your public URL, reverse proxy, and connection timeouts.
settings_network_form_always_secure_body: If any part of the connection is plain HTTP, sign-in silently fails with no error shown.
settings_network_form_always_secure_titl: Only choose this if every hop is HTTPS
settings_network_form_cookie_secure_desc: "Automatic" turns it on only when the site is on HTTPS. If unsure, keep it.
settings_network_form_public_url_descrip: The full address people use to reach this site. If link previews are blank or third-party sign-in fails, this is usually why.
settings_network_form_request_timeout_de: Defaults to 30 seconds. Doesn't apply to uploads.
settings_network_form_trusted_proxies_de: One IP or range per line. For a proxy on the same machine, use 127.0.0.1 and ::1. Keep it narrow — too wide and people can fake their IP and slip past rate limits.
settings_network_form_upload_stall_descr: Ends an upload if no data arrives for this long. Defaults to 30 seconds. Large files can still take as long as they need.
settings_oauth_card_client_id_descriptio: The sign-in button appears once both Client ID and Client Secret are set.
settings_oauth_card_display_name_descrip: Text on the sign-in button. Leave blank to use the service's name.
settings_oauth_card_link_by_email_descri: Existing accounts with the same email can sign in through this service. Anyone can create these accounts in a minute, so with open sign-up this lets people take over others' accounts. Best left off.
settings_oauth_card_link_by_email_label: Link to existing accounts by email
settings_oidc_card_description: Works with standard OIDC services such as Authentik, Keycloak, and Google. Fill in the Issuer URL to turn it on; clear it to turn it off.
settings_oidc_card_display_name_descript: Text on the sign-in button. Leave blank to use the issuer's domain.
settings_oidc_card_group_claim_descripti: Where the service puts group membership. Authentik and Authelia use groups; Keycloak uses realm_access.roles.
settings_oidc_card_issuer_description: Must be https and match the service's value exactly. Clear it to turn OIDC sign-in off.
settings_oidc_card_link_by_email_descrip: Whether a first sign-in through this service attaches to an existing account with the same email.
settings_oidc_card_link_by_email_label: Link to existing accounts by email
settings_oidc_card_open_warning_body: No required group is set. If this is a public service like Google, anyone can sign in. Set a group to restrict it.
settings_oidc_card_open_warning_title: Any account on this service can sign in
settings_oidc_card_required_group_descri: Only members of this group can sign in. Leave blank to allow any account on the service.
settings_oidc_card_scopes_description: Separated by spaces. Must include email; openid is added automatically.
settings_oidc_discovery_field_descriptio: Usually the configuration URL you copy from the service's dashboard. "Read and fill in" sets the Issuer and Scopes below for you.
settings_oidc_discovery_field_missing_em: This service doesn't offer the email scope. Without an email address, every sign-in will fail.
settings_oidc_discovery_field_no_scopes_: The configuration doesn't list its supported scopes, so Scopes was left as is.
settings_oidc_discovery_field_read_succe: The server read it successfully and filled in the fields below
settings_oidc_discovery_field_supported_: This service supports: {scopes}. Scopes below has been adjusted to match.
settings_oidc_discovery_unreadable: Could not read the configuration document at this address.
settings_password_description: Password rules, breached-password checks, and how strongly passwords are hashed.
settings_password_form_memory_kib_descri: Defaults to 19456 KiB (19 MiB) and matters most for security. Check your server's memory before raising it — usage grows with every simultaneous sign-in.
settings_password_form_min_length_descri: Defaults to 8, and can't go lower.
settings_password_form_pwned_enabled_des: Refuse passwords found in known breaches.
settings_password_form_pwned_url_descrip: Defaults to the official service. You can point it at a self-hosted copy.
settings_provider_callback_backchannel_h: Optional. Once registered, signing out or being disabled on the service also signs the person out here.
settings_provider_callback_intro: Register these URLs in the service's dashboard. If one is missing or mistyped, the service will refuse the sign-in.
settings_provider_callback_redirect_hint: OAuth dashboards usually call this Redirect URI, Callback URL, or Redirect URL.
settings_provider_registration_detail_cl: Sign-up is closed, so people without an account can't sign in this way. Existing accounts aren't affected.
settings_provider_registration_detail_in: New people without an invite code are refused. The code goes in the sign-in link (/login?invite=CODE).
settings_provider_registration_detail_op: Anyone the service signs in gets an account automatically. With a public service like Google, that means anyone.
settings_provider_registration_headline_: Only existing accounts can use third-party sign-in
New accounts from third-party sign-in need an invite code
Third-party sign-in creates accounts for new people
settings_schema_absolute_url: Must be an absolute URL starting with http(s)://
settings_schema_access_log_retention_min: Keep the log for at least 1 day while it's on
settings_schema_expiry_order: Default retention cannot exceed the maximum retention
settings_schema_mail_from_required: Please enter a complete sender address
settings_schema_mail_trio_incomplete: SMTP host, from address, and link URL must all be filled in or all left blank
settings_schema_oidc_issuer_https: Must be an https:// issuer URL (http:// only on localhost, 127.0.0.1 or [::1])
settings_schema_oidc_group_claim_require: Required when an issuer is set; the default is groups
settings_schema_oidc_issuer_not_discover: That's the configuration URL, not the issuer. Paste it in the field above and use "Read & fill in"
settings_schema_password_length_order: Minimum length cannot exceed maximum length
settings_schema_pwned_url_required: Must be an absolute URL starting with http(s):// when enabled
settings_schema_throttle_window_floor: At least 1 second — 0 means no limit at all
settings_share_description: Retrieval codes, text shares, and how long downloads and leftovers last.
settings_share_form_access_log_enabled_d: When on, admins can see when each share was retrieved and from where.
settings_share_form_access_log_retention: Defaults to 30 days. At least 1 day while the log is on.
settings_share_form_code_length_descript: Defaults to 8 characters. Longer codes are harder to guess but harder to type.
settings_share_form_inline_threshold_des: A file is buffered in memory until it passes this size, then streamed to storage in parts. Only affects memory use during upload, not where the file ends up. Defaults to 64 KiB.
settings_share_form_max_text_bytes_descr: The largest a single text share can be. Defaults to 1 MiB.
settings_share_form_retain_after_death_d: How long an expired or used-up share is kept before it's really deleted. Defaults to 168 hours (7 days). Until then its link says "expired" instead of "not found".
settings_share_form_ticket_idle_descript: Expires after this long without use; each use resets the clock. Defaults to 1 hour.
settings_share_form_ticket_ttl_descripti: After a download starts, resuming or retrying within this time doesn't use up another retrieval. Defaults to 24 hours.
settings_share_form_upload_session_ttl_d: How long a half-finished upload is kept so it can resume. It counts toward the quota meanwhile. Defaults to 24 hours.
settings_site_description: Your site's name, description, and the language used in link previews.
settings_site_form_description_descripti: The text shown when someone posts a link to this site. Leave blank to show none. Up to {max} characters.
settings_site_form_title_description: The browser tab title and the name shown in link previews. Up to {max} characters.
settings_storage_backends_card_descripti: Where files actually live — a local disk or cloud storage such as S3. New uploads go to the one marked default.
settings_storage_backends_delete_descrip: Only a location with no files in it can be removed.
New uploads go here by default, so it can't be removed. Make another location the default first.
settings_storage_backends_delete_in_use: It still has files, so it can't be removed. Set it to read-only to stop new files, then remove it once its shares have expired.
settings_storage_backends_editor_capacit: Enter it yourself — cloud storage doesn't report its capacity.
settings_storage_backends_editor_descrip: Takes effect as soon as it's saved.
Secrets are never shown; leave them blank to keep the current ones.
settings_storage_backends_editor_direct_: Download straight from storage, saving bandwidth. S3 and GCS only.
settings_storage_backends_editor_name_de: Can't be changed after it's created.
settings_storage_backends_editor_read_on: Stops taking new files. Files already here can still be downloaded.
settings_storage_description: Where files are kept, how they're uploaded, and how leftovers are cleaned up.
settings_storage_form_part_size_descript: How much of a large file is sent at a time. Defaults to 8 MiB, minimum 5 MiB. On Cloudflare R2, set it to 5 MiB.
settings_theme_description: The colors and light or dark mode visitors see when they first arrive.
settings_throttle_description: Caps how often something can happen in a period of time, to stop guessing and abuse.
settings_throttle_form_login_protects: Failed sign-ins to one account from one IP.
settings_throttle_form_lookup_protects: Lookups of codes that don't exist. The shorter your codes, the more this matters.
settings_throttle_form_max_tracked_keys_: How many IPs or accounts can be counted at once. Defaults to 10000, up to 100000. Higher uses more memory.
settings_throttle_form_registration_prot: Sign-up confirmations sent to one address.
settings_throttle_form_reset_protects: Reset emails sent to one address.
settings_throttle_form_share_protects: Wrong passwords for one share from one IP.
settings_throttle_form_source_protects: Too low and people on shared networks get blocked.
settings_upload_description: Who can upload, how long files are kept, and how much space they can take.
settings_upload_form_allow_anonymous_des: When off, only signed-in accounts can upload.
settings_upload_form_default_expiry_desc: Used when the uploader doesn't pick one. Defaults to 7 days; 0 uses the maximum.
settings_upload_form_max_expiry_descript: The longest an uploader can choose. Defaults to 30 days; 0 means no limit.
settings_upload_form_max_total_bytes_des: The limit for all shares combined. Defaults to 0 (no limit). Worth setting if anyone can upload, so the disk doesn't fill up.
users_action_delete_description: The account will be reduced to a "Deleted account" row — this can't be undone. Their uploaded shares are not deleted with it; they become anonymous shares and stay active. Use "End all shares" separately to clear those.
users_action_disable_description: They'll be signed out immediately and won't be able to sign in again; their API tokens are invalidated at the same time. Their shares still work for recipients. You can re-enable this account at any time.
users_action_last_admin_error: This is the last account that can grant permissions — hand that permission to someone else first.
users_action_remove_shares_description: Every share this account uploaded becomes invalid immediately, and any links already handed out stop working too — this can't be undone. The account itself is unaffected.
users_card_description: "Unassigned" means nobody has decided what this account can do yet — that's different from deliberately giving it the guest role.
users_set_role_dialog_description: An account has at most one role. Choosing "Unassigned" means the account can sign in but can't do anything.
settings_form_footer_leave_description: The changes you made on this page will be lost.
settings_site_identity_description: Shown in browser tabs and link previews.
settings_site_language_description: The language the site opens in for visitors who haven't picked one and whose browser doesn't ask for a language we offer. Also used on link previews, which have no viewer to ask.
settings_appearance_card_description: What signed-out visitors and users who haven't picked their own will see.
settings_theme_personal_description: Only changes what you see. Applies right away — no need to save.
settings_account_signup_description: These also apply to third-party sign-in.
settings_account_sessions_description: How long people stay signed in and how long sign-in history is kept.
settings_auth_providers_description: Let people sign in with OIDC, GitHub, or Discord. Each one is saved separately.
settings_provider_callback_no_public_url: Without it there's no URL to register here, and third-party sign-in fails. Set it under
settings_password_length_description: Length does more to stop guessing than character rules.
settings_password_composition_descriptio: Only checked when a new password is set; existing passwords keep working. All off by default.
settings_password_pwned_description: Refuse new passwords that appear in known breaches. The password itself is never sent out.
settings_password_hashing_description: Higher values are harder to crack but make each sign-in cost more. Only affects passwords set from now on.
settings_upload_who_description: Whether signed-out visitors can upload. What signed-in people can do depends on their role.
settings_upload_rate_limit_moved: To limit how many requests one IP can make, go to
settings_upload_expiry_description: How long until shares are deleted automatically. This affects disk usage more than any size limit.
settings_upload_size_description: How much the whole site can hold, and how large one upload can be.
settings_upload_form_max_body_descriptio: Can only be changed with an environment variable, followed by a restart:
settings_share_code_description: The last part of a share link, which can also be typed on the home page.
settings_share_text_description: Limits for text shares such as code and notes.
settings_share_lifecycle_description: How long download links work, and how long unfinished or expired shares stick around.
settings_share_access_log_description: Records the time, IP, and browser of every retrieval. Off by default.
settings_share_form_access_log_notice: This keeps visitors' IP addresses and browser details. If you turn it on, let people know on your site.
settings_storage_upload_description: How large files are sent to storage.
settings_storage_form_split_description: When no single location has room, spread the file across several. Off by default.
settings_storage_form_split_warning_titl: Split files can't be downloaded directly
settings_storage_form_split_warning_body: Downloads have to go through this server or be reassembled in the browser, which uses more of the server's bandwidth.
settings_storage_reconcile_description: Regularly compares storage with the database and removes files that no share points to.
settings_storage_form_reconcile_interval: Defaults to every 24 hours; 0 turns it off. Cloud storage often bills per request, so you may want it less often.
settings_storage_form_reconcile_off_noti: Reconciliation is off, so files left behind by failed uploads won't be removed.
settings_storage_form_reconcile_grace_de: How old an unclaimed file must be before it's deleted. Defaults to 24 hours. Too short and it may delete files that are still uploading.
settings_throttle_group_source_descripti: Sign-ins, uploads, lookups, and other costly requests share this allowance. People on the same network share an IP, so it's kept loose.
settings_throttle_group_mail_description: Limits how many emails one address can receive, so nobody can flood someone else's inbox.
settings_throttle_form_verification_prot: Verification emails sent to one address. Counted separately from reset emails.
settings_throttle_group_other_descriptio: Features that use bandwidth or an outside service.
settings_throttle_form_speed_protects: Speed tests from one IP. Every test counts, not just failures.
settings_throttle_form_pwned_protects: Lookups made while someone types a password. Doesn't use the overall allowance.
settings_network_address_description: Link previews and third-party sign-in both need it.
settings_network_proxy_description: Set these when the site sits behind a proxy such as Nginx or Caddy.
settings_network_timeouts_description: How long to wait before giving up on a connection.
settings_mail_relay_description: The outside service that sends the email.
settings_mail_sender_description: Who the email is from, and where its links point.
settings_mail_links_description: How long the links in emails keep working.
settings_feature_card_description: A feature that's off looks to the outside as if it never existed.
settings_feature_form_admin_lockout_desc: To restore it, run this on the server and restart:
users_quota_dialog_description: Applies to this account only and overrides its role. The site-wide limits still apply.
users_quota_inherit_description: Follows the role, and changes when the role does.
manage_share_forget_hint: Only removes it from this browser's list; it does not delete the file.
manage_share_gone: This share has expired, run out, or been deleted.
permission_invites_delete_hint: Invalidate invites that haven't been used yet
permission_invites_read_hint: See all invites and whether they were used
permission_roles_read_hint: See the role list and each role's permissions
permission_roles_write_hint: Create, edit and delete roles — deciding who can do what
permission_settings_read_hint: See quotas, sign-up mode, storage backends and other settings
permission_settings_write_hint: Change settings that affect everyone, including storage backends
permission_shares_read_any_hint: See everyone's uploads in the admin console
permission_tokens_manage_hint: Create and revoke their own API tokens
permission_users_read_hint: See all accounts with their roles and usage
permission_users_write_hint: Change other accounts, such as their role or suspension
role_owner_description: Everything, including removing accounts and content.
role_admin_description: Help run the instance: accounts, invites, and looking at what is here.
role_member_description: Upload, and manage what you uploaded.
settings_oidc_card_link_by_email_when_ve: Only if the service verified the email
settings_oidc_card_link_always_warning_t: Anyone who can claim someone else's email on this service can take over their account here
settings_oidc_card_link_always_warning_b: Links regardless of whether the service verified the email. Only use this with a service where you hand out the accounts, such as Synology, Entra ID or your own Authentik — never with one that lets anyone sign up.
settings_oidc_card_link_unverified_warni: This service doesn't say whether an email is verified, so this won't link anyone

The service's discovery document doesn't list email_verified, so nothing will ever be linked automatically. Choose “Always” (mind the risk), or have users sign in with their password and link the service themselves.
settings_provider_registration_field_des: Whether someone signing in here for the first time gets an account. By default this follows the sign-up setting.
settings_provider_registration_headline_: New people this service signs in get an account automatically
settings_provider_registration_detail_al: The sign-up setting is ignored and no invite code is needed. Who gets in is decided only by the service and the required group.
settings_provider_registration_headline_: Only existing accounts can sign in with this service
settings_provider_registration_detail_ne: No account is created for anyone new, whatever the sign-up setting says. Accounts already linked to this service are unaffected.
settings_provider_registration_world_tit: Any {provider} account can get an account here
settings_provider_registration_world_bod: {provider} can't be limited to a group, so “Always create” opens sign-up to the whole world, with no invite code. Unless that's what you want, switch back to “Follow sign-up setting”.
settings_oidc_card_open_registration_tit: Any account on this service can get an account here
settings_oidc_card_open_registration_bod: No required group is set and “Always create” is on, with no invite code. With a public service like Google, that opens sign-up to the whole world. Set a group, or switch back to “Follow sign-up setting”.
share_scanning_description: Checking this share for malware. It opens on its own when done, usually within seconds.
settings_scan_description: Check uploads with a scanner you run, before they can be downloaded.
settings_scan_service_description: Tessera does not include one. Run ClamAV or an HTTP scanner and point this at it.
settings_scan_form_url_description: clamd://host:3310 for the ClamAV daemon, or http(s)://… for a service that takes the file as a POST body. Empty turns scanning off.
settings_scan_form_authorization_descrip: Sent to an HTTP scanner as Authorization, e.g. Bearer …. Not used by clamd.
settings_scan_form_off_body: Uploads are handed out without being checked.
settings_scan_form_encryption_body: End-to-end encryption is on, and ciphertext can't be scanned. To scan everything, turn encryption off under Features.
settings_schema_scan_url_invalid: Must start with clamd://, http:// or https://; a clamd address needs a host and port
auth_mfa_description: Enter the six-digit code from your authenticator app.
auth_mfa_code_hint: Don't have your phone? Enter one of your recovery codes instead.
user_mfa_description: Ask for a code from an authenticator app after your password. Signing in with a passkey or a linked provider is unaffected.
user_mfa_setup_description: First confirm it's you, then scan a QR code with your authenticator app.
user_mfa_scan_description: Scan it with an app such as Google Authenticator or 1Password, then enter the code it shows.
user_mfa_scan_manual: Can't scan? Enter this key manually:
user_mfa_code_hint: The six digits in the app; they change every 30 seconds.
user_mfa_enabled_done: Two-step verification is on. If you lose your phone, sign in with these recovery codes.
user_mfa_recovery_warning: These codes are shown only this once, and each works once. Keep them somewhere safe.
user_mfa_regenerate_description: Your old recovery codes stop working immediately.
user_mfa_regenerated_done: New recovery codes are ready; the old ones no longer work.
user_mfa_disable_description: You'll sign in with just your password, and all recovery codes are discarded.
user_mfa_code_or_recovery_hint: Enter the code from your authenticator app to confirm it's you.
user_passkeys_add_description: After confirming it's you, your browser will ask you to create the passkey with a fingerprint, face or security key.
users_action_reset_mfa_description: For someone who lost both their phone and recovery codes. They'll sign in with just their password and can set it up again. Make sure it's really them first.
upload_encrypt_link_hint: Sealed in this browser. The key is part of the link, so anyone with the whole link can open it, and the server never can.
upload_encrypt_password_hint: Sealed in this browser with a key from your password. The link and the password are enough to open it; the password can never be changed or recovered.
upload_encrypt_use_password: Use a password as the key
upload_encrypt_password_too_short: The password needs at least {min} characters.
upload_result_password_is_key: Password is the encryption key and cannot be changed
share_needs_full_link_description: This share is end-to-end encrypted and its key is part of the full link. Ask the sender for the whole link, including everything after #.
share_bad_key_description: The key in this link does not open this share. Check that the link was copied in full.
share_decrypt_failed: The file could not be decrypted. It may have been altered.
settings_share_encryption_description: Whether uploaders can seal a share in their browser.
settings_share_form_encryption_descripti: Lets uploaders seal a share in their browser so this server cannot read it. Off by default. Turning it off only stops new encrypted shares; existing ones can still be downloaded.
manage_share_key_missing: This share is end-to-end encrypted and its key is not in this browser, so this link cannot open it. Use the full link you copied when uploading.
api_error_unknown: Something went wrong. Please try again.
api_error_not_found: We couldn't find that. It may have been deleted.
api_error_not_signed_in: You're not signed in, or your session has expired. Please sign in again.
api_error_permission_denied: Your account isn't allowed to do that.
api_error_session_required: This needs a signed-in browser session, not an API token.
api_error_password_change_required: Set a new password before continuing.
api_error_payload_too_large: That's larger than the size limit.
api_error_insufficient_storage_role: The storage allowed for your role is full.
api_error_too_many_requests: Too many attempts. Please wait a moment and try again.
api_error_too_many_requests_seconds: Too many attempts. Try again in {seconds} s.
api_error_too_many_requests_minutes: Too many attempts. Try again in {minutes} min.
api_error_scanning: This is still being checked for malware. Try again in a moment.
api_error_unsupported_media_type: That content type isn't accepted here.
api_error_timeout: Nothing arrived for a while. Please try again.
api_error_unavailable: The service is unavailable right now. Please try again later.
api_error_internal: The server ran into an error. Please try again later.
api_error_bad_request: The request wasn't valid. Reload the page and try again.
api_error_value_reserved: "{value}" is reserved and can't be used.
api_error_conflicting_fields: Those fields can't be set together.
api_error_rule_needs_mixed_case: Password must contain both upper- and lowercase letters.
api_error_rule_no_spaces: {field} can't contain spaces or control characters.
api_error_rule_missing_domain: Email needs a domain, such as example.com.
api_error_rule_email: Enter a valid email, such as name@example.com.
api_error_rule_allowed_characters: Username may contain only letters, digits, underscores and hyphens.
api_error_rule_starts_alphanumeric: Username must start with a letter or a digit.
api_error_rule_code_alphabet: Codes contain only digits and the letters A–Z, without I, L, O or U.
api_error_rule_http_url: Enter an address starting with http:// or https://.
api_error_reauthentication_required: Sign in again to confirm it's you, then try again.
api_error_mfa_code_incorrect: That code isn't right. Check your authenticator app and try again.
api_error_mfa_challenge_unusable: This sign-in took too long. Enter your password again.
api_error_mfa_already_enabled: Two-step sign-in is already on. Turn it off before setting it up again.
api_error_passkey_rejected: That passkey couldn't sign you in. Try again.
api_error_passkey_invalid: That passkey couldn't be added. Try again.
api_error_password_breached: This password has appeared in a data breach. Choose a different one.
api_error_registration_closed: This server isn't accepting new accounts.
api_error_invite_required: An invite code is required to sign up.
api_error_invite_unusable: That invite code is invalid, used up or expired.
api_error_registration_link_unusable: This confirmation link no longer works. Please sign up again.
api_error_reset_link_unusable: This reset link no longer works. Please request a new one.
api_error_verification_link_unusable: This confirmation link no longer works. Please request a new one.
api_error_email_taken: That email is already in use.
api_error_account_exists: That username or email is already in use.
api_error_last_administrator: That would leave nobody able to administer this server.
api_error_last_sign_in_method: This is the only way left into this account. Set a password first.
api_error_unknown_permission: That includes a permission this version doesn't have.
api_error_role_name_taken: A role with that name already exists.
api_error_builtin_role_immutable: Built-in roles can't be changed or removed.
api_error_share_exhausted: This share has reached its retrieval limit.
api_error_share_content_removed: This share's content has already been removed, so it can't be extended or given more retrievals.
api_error_share_is_file: This share is a file and can't be opened as text.
api_error_share_encrypted: This share is end-to-end encrypted and needs its key to open.
api_error_share_password_is_key: This share's key comes from its password, so the password can't be changed or removed.
api_error_share_is_text: This share holds text and can't take files.
api_error_text_too_large: That text is too long. Upload it as a file instead.
api_error_text_too_large_limit: That text is over the {limit} limit. Upload it as a file instead.
api_error_code_space_exhausted: No free retrieval code could be found. Contact the administrator.
api_error_archive_too_large_for_zip: This is too large for a zip. Download it as tar or 7z instead.
api_error_encryption_disabled: This server doesn't accept end-to-end encrypted shares.
api_error_upload_interrupted: Something went wrong during the upload. Please upload again.
api_error_upload_abandoned: This upload was abandoned. Please upload again.
api_error_resumable_unsupported: This server's storage can't resume uploads.
api_error_setting_unknown: "{key}" isn't a setting this version has.
api_error_setting_secret: "{key}" holds a credential and is set through the environment.
api_error_setting_fixed_at_boot: "{key}" can't change while the server runs. Set it through the environment.
api_error_provider_insecure: An identity provider must use https, unless it's on a private address.
api_error_backend_credential_unreadable: A stored credential can't be opened with the current key.
api_error_backend_in_use: That storage backend still holds files.
scan_status_pending_description: Recipients can't open it until the scan is done, usually within seconds. You can copy the link now.
scan_status_infected_description: The scanner detected {threat}. This link no longer opens.
scan_status_skipped_encrypted: End-to-end encrypted, so it can't be scanned
scan_status_skipped_too_large: Too large to scan; shared unscanned
scan_status_deferred_description: The scanner is unavailable, so the file is shared for now and will be scanned once it's back.
manage_share_blocked: The malware scanner detected {threat}, so this share was disabled.
settings_storage_backends_url_s3_bucket: The bucket name is invalid: 3–63 characters, lowercase letters, digits, dots and hyphens only.
settings_storage_backends_delete_files_n: This only removes the location from Tessera. The bucket or folder itself, and anything in it, is not touched.
settings_storage_backends_delete_confirm: Confirm it's you to remove this location.
settings_storage_backends_url_malformed: This isn't a valid URL. Check for a typo.
settings_storage_backends_url_scheme: Unsupported scheme. Use s3://, gs://, az://, abfs://, http(s)://, file:///path, memory://, or a plain folder path.
settings_storage_backends_url_azure_cont: The container name is invalid: 3–63 characters, lowercase letters, digits and hyphens only.
settings_storage_backends_url_host: The URL is missing a host name.
settings_storage_backends_url_file: Use file:///absolute/path (three slashes), or just the folder path.
settings_storage_backends_url_no_credent: A username and password in this URL are not used. Pick the matching type above and fill in its fields, or set them in the server's environment.
settings_storage_backends_url_gcs_bucket: The bucket name is invalid: 3–63 characters, lowercase letters, digits, dots and hyphens only (GCS also allows underscores).
api_error_backend_name_taken: A storage location with that name already exists.
settings_storage_backends_editor_name_ta: A location with this name already exists.
admin_command_description: Go to a page or setting, or run an action
settings_reset_description: Put settings changed in this panel back to the server's own value: the environment variable if one is set, otherwise the built-in default.
settings_reset_scope_note: Storage locations, roles, accounts and invite codes are not settings and stay as they are. The full list of default values is in the documentation.
settings_reset_card_description: By the page each one is on. Resetting takes effect at once.
settings_reset_empty: Nothing has been changed in this panel; every setting is the server's own.
settings_reset_lockout: {name} is left alone: the server's value is off, and resetting it would lock you out of this panel. Turn it off from Features if that is what you want.
settings_reset_dialog_description: They go back to the server's values and take effect at once.
settings_reset_dialog_secrets: {count} stored secrets (sign-in client secrets, mail credentials) are cleared. What uses them stops working until they are entered again.
settings_consequence_access: The next sweep deletes {count} recorded accesses
settings_consequence_signins: The next sweep deletes {count} past sign-ins
api_error_backend_credentials_required: Moving to a different host or endpoint needs the credentials again (key:secret@).
settings_storage_backends_editor_moves_f: {size} of files are stored here. Changing the location does not move them: copy them to the new location first, or existing shares will stop downloading.
settings_storage_backends_editor_capacit: No limit on how much is stored here.
settings_storage_backends_path_descripti: A path on the server, created if missing. Relative paths start from the server's working directory.
settings_storage_backends_endpoint_descr: The address of a self-hosted or compatible service such as Garage, SeaweedFS or R2. Leave blank for AWS. An http:// address allows unencrypted connections.
settings_storage_backends_endpoint_inval: Enter an address starting with http:// or https://.
settings_storage_backends_region_descrip: For AWS, the bucket's region. For a self-hosted service, the region it is configured with: Garage's default is garage.
settings_storage_backends_service_accoun: Leave blank to use the server's environment or default credentials.
settings_storage_backends_account_key_de: Leave blank to use the server's environment.
settings_storage_backends_other_descript: For a location the types above cannot describe. Stored advanced options are left as they are.
settings_storage_backends_keep_placehold: Leave blank to keep the current one
settings_storage_backends_keep_descripti: Current: {key}. To replace it, fill in both fields.
settings_storage_backends_pair_incomplet: Fill this in with the other field, or leave both blank to keep the current ones.
settings_confirm_description: A shorter retention period applies to what is already stored. The next sweep removes the following, and it cannot be brought back.
settings_scanner_status_description: Learned from the scans themselves. An idle scanner is sent an empty file every 15 minutes, and a failing one every 5.
settings_scanner_status_down_body: Files are handed out unscanned until it answers, then scanned afterwards.
settings_scanner_status_not_checked: Not checked since start-up or since the address changed.
dashboard_scanner_unreachable: The scanner is not answering. New uploads are handed out unscanned until it does; {deferred} waiting to be scanned.
device_enter_description: Enter the code shown by tess login.
device_confirm_title: Allow this device to sign in?
device_confirm_description: Allow only if it matches the code in your terminal
device_warning: It will be able to manage your shares. Deny if you didn't run tess login yourself.
device_approved_description: You can go back to your terminal.
device_denied_description: The device was not given access. You can close this page.
device_not_found: This code isn't valid, or it has expired. Run tess login again for a new one.
api_error_device_authorization_pending: Waiting for the sign-in to be approved.
api_error_device_code_unusable: This sign-in request has expired. Start again.
